en.title: Daily Action Flow, September 27, 2026
en.description: Eight bounded actions distinguish evidence of recovery from promises of autonomy.
en.centralJudgment: Reconcile the effect before repeating the command. The essay and Friday flow snapshot are completed research artifacts; proposed tests, project awards, customer outcomes and future results remain open.
en.fieldLine: Eight signals. Defined work. Honest completion.

actions.title: Specify the paired model evaluation
actions.why: Agent infrastructure earns its place by reducing the total work needed to finish a task.
steps: Save a paired-evaluation specification for ten fixed, public-input tasks, with cost per accepted result including retries and reviewer minutes as the acceptance metric; execution remains pending.
Keep the dated evidence and record execution only after the specified acceptance condition is met.
actions.done: READY; ten-task specification saved, evaluation unexecuted.

actions.title: Save the robot acceptance card
actions.why: Physical AI diligence should include recovery behavior alongside perception and model capability.
steps: Save one robot-acceptance card requiring evidence for lost-reply recovery, stale-observation handling and operator intervention; mark all untested fields unknown.
Keep the dated evidence and record execution only after the specified acceptance condition is met.
actions.done: READY; lost replies, stale observations and intervention evidence required.

actions.domain: Crypto Capital Flows and Web3 Health
actions.title: Close Friday’s missing-row observation
actions.why: A change in evidence quality deserves a state update without becoming a trading signal.
steps: Close the September 25 missing-row watchpoint with the dated complete snapshot and US$134.5 million total, retaining the revision caveat and leaving broader activity unconfirmed.
Keep the dated evidence and record execution only after the specified acceptance condition is met.
actions.done: COMPLETE; September 25 provider row now complete at US$134.5m, revision caveat retained.

actions.title: Define the programme evidence threshold
actions.why: Payments experience helps distinguish a funded infrastructure programme from a proven improvement for recipients.
steps: Save a programme evidence card whose upgrade threshold is published end-to-end delivery cost, recipient access and reconciliation performance against an existing route.
Keep the dated evidence and record execution only after the specified acceptance condition is met.
actions.done: READY; cost, access and reconciliation comparison specified, outcomes unmeasured.

actions.title: Publish When Robots Lose the Reply
actions.why: This joins agents, robotics and payment-system thinking through a useful recovery mechanism.
steps: Publish When Robots Lose the Reply at the [canonical destination](https://iamrobin.ai/ouroboros/202609/20260927/action_item/), with the thesis that dependable autonomy must reconcile effects before repeating commands; use a lost-reply example, durable command identity, physical-state verification and a bounded test specification as the evidence spine, grounded in DroneDeploy, ROS 2 and AWS documentation, and archive a LinkedIn derivative.
Keep the dated evidence and record execution only after the specified acceptance condition is met.
actions.done: COMPLETE as an editorial artifact; public delivery has separate gates.
actions.deepDiveTitle: Publish When Robots Lose the Reply

actions.domain: AI Infrastructure, Career and Capital Projects
actions.title: Separate SPARK delivery milestones
actions.why: Tracking that path is an infrastructure underwriting skill; this announcement establishes no job opening.
steps: Save a SPARK milestone card with separate selection, executed award and energized-capacity fields, advancing each only on its own dated evidence.
Keep the dated evidence and record execution only after the specified acceptance condition is met.
actions.done: READY; selection recorded, executed award and energized capacity UNKNOWN.

actions.title: Keep Ema at WATCH
actions.why: The relevant diligence connects agent outcomes to renewals, service burden and capital terms.
steps: Record WATCH, upgrading only when independently corroborated customer economics, financing terms and actual investment access are available; no application or transaction follows.
Keep the dated evidence and record execution only after the specified acceptance condition is met.
actions.done: WATCHING; customer economics, terms and access remain unverified.

actions.title: Retain the Micron catalyst card
actions.why: An unchanged precommitment protects the thesis from being rewritten after the result.
steps: Retain the existing Micron catalyst card through September 30, accepting an update only from released results that address margins, capital spending and customer commitments.
Keep the dated evidence and record execution only after the specified acceptance condition is met.
actions.done: WATCHING; existing September 30 catalyst retained without inventing new results.

actions.done: READY；要求回执丢失、过期观测及人工介入证据。

actions.title: 发布机器人丢了回执之后

steps: 在[规范页面](https://iamrobin.ai/ouroboros/202609/20260927/action_item/)发布When Robots Lose the Reply，中文工作标题为《机器人丢了回执之后》；论点是可靠自主系统应先核对实际效果再重复指令，以回执丢失案例、持久指令身份、物理状态核验及有边界的测试规格为四段证据主线，依据DroneDeploy、ROS 2与AWS文档，并归档LinkedIn衍生稿。
